_trimmed.why: The untrimmed capture is 3.9 MB. Everything the tests assert is preserved EXACTLY; what was cut is named here so no number read off this file is mistaken for the whole response.
_trimmed.rule: Every survey hit that any via entry references is KEPT — a first attempt cut them and the 101-edge collapse this file exists to witness became 0 edges. Plus 4 filler hits per stage for arm coverage.
_trimmed.degree_zero_NOT_witnessable: The trim rule keeps every survey hit a via entry references, so it keeps the CONNECTED hits by construction and only 4 arbitrary unconnected ones per stage. This file therefore reads 10 of 52 nodes at degree zero (19%); the live response it was cut from reads 80 of 155 (51%). Any assertion about the unconnected POPULATION must be made against the wire, not against this file. Same species as the 101-edge collapse noted in `rule` above: a trim that preserves one property destroys another.
